_comment: The 12 February 2023 repeat-election result, shown in its own accordion. parties.baselineSource is "partiesdata" — the Berlin PartiesData entry carries these same shares as last_results — so this file is the accordion only, and it adds the seat counts PartiesData does not hold. Parties below the threshold won no seats, hence null. The SPD and the Greens both took 18.4%: the SPD finished second by 53 votes.
